messages:
anna: Quick thread — I'm drafting the release notes + internal announcement for tomorrow's deploy (v2.11.0). Putting the draft below. Please do quick pass for accuracy and sign off on the change window and rollback plan. Will post to #all-hands + email once we have :thumbsup: from release + comms.

anna: Draft release notes (internal):
```
- v2.11.0 (runtime optimizations, Mar 19 2024)
  - Reduced token latency by ~18% for typical chat workloads via improved attention scheduling.
  - Fixed memory leak observed during KV-cache warmup on long-running sessions.
  - Added optional model-version pinning per-route (beta).
  - Migration: background quantization job updated — no customer action required.
  - Known issues: rare 504s during high-concurrency bursts; auto-fallback enabled.
+ Deployment plan: canary -> 10% traffic (30m) -> 50% (30m) -> full roll.
+ Change window: 02:00 - 04:00 UTC (low traffic).
+ Rollback: immediate toggle to previous serving group + block new canaries; run rollback job which re-applies v2.10.9 label.
```

mike: Couple edits: mention the pinned-version flag name (`pin_model_version=true`) and the exact canary metric we watch (p95 latency, error-rate). Also change window to 02:00 - 03:30 UTC (we only need 90m).

jason: From on-call: confirm rollback steps are scripted and tested. We should include the runbook link and who owns the rollback action.

anna: Good call. Updated draft: replaced change window to 02:00-03:30 UTC. Adding runbook link and owners.

anna: Updated snippet:
```
+ Change window: 02:00 - 03:30 UTC.
+ Rollback: runbook https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-rollback. Owner: eng-release on-call (see rotation).
+ Monitoring: p95 latency and 5xx rate. Alerts will auto-pager on sustained >2x baseline for 5m.
```

sophia: From comms: Need a one-line plain-language blurb for the all-hands: something like: "Performance update: reduced average response times and improved memory stability for long chat sessions." Keep it non-technical. Also include a short ops note for internal embargoed customers (two sentences).

elena: Product: Add customer impact section — call out that embeddings/embedding-cost unaffected. Mention no API contract changes; the pinned-version beta requires opt-in. Also add that Dedicated customers will have scheduled maintenance via their account rep.

mike: Confirming deploy flags: `--canary-percent=10 --canary-duration=30m` then `--canary-percent=50 --canary-duration=30m`. Canary health checks: p95 < 1.2x baseline AND 5xx rate < 0.5%. If either fails, auto-rollback triggers.

jason: We tested the rollback script yesterday in staging, worked as expected. I volunteer to be primary to execute rollback if paged. Backups of model artifacts verified.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by mike at 2024-03-19T02:00:00Z for release v2.11.0. Jobs: runtime-deploy-2024-03-19-02. CID: dpl-9f2b.

anna: OK — final items: sophia will craft the all-hands blurb, elena will add customer-facing paragraph, mike will run the deploy, jason is on rollback. I'll post the announcement to #all-hands and send the internal email at +10m after successful full roll.

sophia: Drafted blurb for all-hands: "Performance improvements across our runtime reduce typical response times and improve stability for long-running chats. No action required from customers." Also internal ops note: "If you manage customer fleets, monitor your dashboards during the 02:00-03:30 UTC window; reach out to eng-release for any incidents."

mike: I'm queuing the jobs now. Final config posted to the deploy channel:
```
service: runtime
image: registry.redwood/v2.11.0
flags: --canary-percent=10 --canary-duration=30m --monitor=p95,5xx
change_window: 02:00-03:30 UTC
```

deploy-bot: Deploy started: runtime-deploy-2024-03-19-02 (dpl-9f2b). Canary(10%) in progress.

deploy-bot: Canary health report (30m): p95=0.98x baseline, 5xx=0.1% -> passing. Promoting to 50%.

deploy-bot: Canary(50%) health report (30m): p95=1.05x baseline, 5xx=0.2% -> passing. Proceeding to full roll.

deploy-bot: Full rollout complete: runtime v2.11.0 deployed to 100% traffic. Downtime: none.

anna: :tada: Great work team. Posting to #all-hands and sending the email now. Thanks for the quick reviews.

elena: Filed the customer-facing note with support and account reps. Will follow up if any customers flag regressions.

jason: Leaving post-deploy checks running. Will report any anomalies in this thread.

mike: Logs archived at https://redwood.internal/logs/dpl-9f2b and changelog updated in the release board.

anna: Thread closed unless anything else pops up. Thanks.
